Membership logic is placed in rdflib/namespace.py on the Namespace class (generated/rdflib/namespace.py:142-144) and the ClosedNamespace class (generated/rdflib/namespace.py:218-220), the same classes the reference changes (reference namespace.py:149 and :223).

Namespace.__contains__(self, ref) returns bool(ref.startswith(self)) (generated namespace.py:142-144); reference returns ref.startswith(self) (reference namespace.py:149-150). Same semantics.

ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns any(uri == ref for uri in self.__uris.values()) (generated namespace.py:218-220); reference returns ref in self.__uris.values() (reference namespace.py:223-). Same membership result because Identifier.__eq__ is type-strict (base rdflib/term.py:140-160), so Literal and plain-str operands return False in both.
_RDFNamespace (namespace.py:478 RDF = _RDFNamespace()) inherits the new ClosedNamespace.__contains__ with no override.

__contains__ is the Python membership protocol hook, defined on Namespace (generated namespace.py:142) and ClosedNamespace (generated namespace.py:218), and is inherited by _RDFNamespace.
